[Edit]: Totally was a thread for this already, it just hasn't had a new post for awhile. Still, going to leave this thread up, since it at the very least is a nice compilled list of them all, something the other thread doesn't seem to have. The other thread has better overall speculation and you can find the link for it here: https://greaterthangames.com/forum/topic/the-potential-scions-of-oblivaeon-8608

As a preface, I first want to say that if this is a repeat of another topic, or if this question has been answered before, I apologize and will move my conversation or delete it if it's redundant. But if not, I feel this topic must be discussed!

So with the most recent kickstarter update, I believe we now know all but ONE of the scions from Oblivaeon. While we have not seen all their cards yet, nor gotten complete oficial confirmations on all of these (I think), I believe this is the comprehensive list we have thus far. If you know the official confirmation for any of these, please post it, and I will try to update this list accordingly.

1. Progeny (Kickstarter Update 6)

2. Aeon Master (Kickstarter Update 37)

3. Dark Mind (Kickstarter Update 37)

4. Sanction (Kickstarter Update 37)

5. Borr (Kickstarter Update 39)

6. Empyreon (Kickstarter Update 39)

7. Nixious (Kickstarter Update 39)

8. Faultless (Mentioned in several episodes of the letters page podcast, including Expatriette, Setback, and Mr. Fixer)

9. Voidsoul (Art done on Twitch Stream, also mentioned in the F.I.L.T.E.R. episode of the letters page podcast)

10. ???

 

So by my count, if we consider Voidspawn a confirmed Scion (please correct me if I'm wrong on that one), we only have 1 scion still unaccounted for. So my question is, who is this mystery Scion? Christopher has said the scions will be about half old characters and half new ones, so he/she could by either one (depending on how you count Voidspawn, since as far as I know he's never been named in the card game).

So who do we think this last Scion is? Let's try to figure this out!

posts.cooked:
So Dark Psuedonym over on the Kickstarter just gave me a truly terrifying thought that I'd like to share with everyone.

 

What if instead of Voss Tim Cosing is Spite/Jack Donovan?

 

In terms of "worst person to get cosmic power" Spite trumps that list by miles, and, it is interesting that we haven't had an episode of the Letters page for Spite. Maybe he's too niche to get his own page, because all of his story is told by Gloomweaver and Wraith, but also it is possible that they are saving his episode so that they don't spoil him being a Scion.

 

And the message from the Scion of "Trust me, I'm a much better choice than Oblivaeon to have all that power" takes a much darker tone if it is coming from a psycho serial killer instead of from a warlord. Spite wouldn't want to destroy reality, he'd want to play with it. And isn't that just enought to make you shudder.

 

The only reason I could think of that ol' Smiling Jack couldn't be a Scion is because Gloomweaver "ate" him to make Skinwalker, and there might not be enough of him left to be turned into a Scion.

 

Still, it was a fascinating idea that was scary enough I wanted to share it.

Is "Dark Psuedonym" my fleshchild duplicate?   (I'm Darth Pseudonym over on Kickstarter, and also on Steam, btw.)

I'm with you on the 'very worst person to become a scion' thing, but I don't know where you're getting the idea that Gloomy ate Jack's soul.  According to the Gloomweaver episode of Letters Page, they "switched places" when Gloomy inhabited the body to become the Skinwalker, and they never mentioned Spite again in that episode – which means Jack's soul got shoved off into the Realm of Discord somewhere, along with the majority of Gloomweaver's power (at least until Gloomypants was able to go into Rotting God form).

 

However, all that said, when I go back and read the Scion's Aid ARG fragment (which I haven't in six months), it sends me back to thinking it's gotta be Voss.  I know each of these points has counterarguments, but:

  1. The spoken lines sound more like something Voss would say than Spite. (In particular, "little heroes of Earth" sounds like an alien warlord.)

  2. The silhouette could certainly fit Voss (in a 'take a knee' pose), but would only fit Spite if he's in a particularly buff but not mutated state.

  3. Spite's soul was dumped into the Realm of Discord, which is weird and trippy but hardly 'beyond space and time', which is where the Scion says it was found.  But at 1:09 in the Gloomweaver Letters Page, that's precisely the phrase used to describe where Nightmist banishes her foes: "She's sending them nowhere.  She's sending them beyond space and time.  They are nowhere and nowhen." (Props to Chogb001, who noted this back in April, which helped me find the exact quote.)

 

I'd love to see Scion Spite, but the evidence for Voss is stronger.
